description: This file defines utility functions and classes for formatting matcher messages, handling errors, and logging within the Playwright testing framework, specifically related to matcher hints and error reporting.

classes.name: ExpectError
classes.description: Custom error class for wrapping Jest errors with additional message and stack trace formatting.

methods.name: formatMatcherMessage
methods.description: Formats a detailed matcher message for test output, including expected, received, diff, and logs.

methods.name: isJestError
methods.description: Type guard to check if an error is a JestError with matcherResult.

methods.name: callLogText
methods.description: Generates a formatted string of the call log if present.
